# Condensed matter and materials

<!-- Generated by scripts/build_prompts.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Open only the cards whose "Applies when" line matches the paper. Paths are relative to this folder; the index of all folders is [../../INDEX.md](../../INDEX.md).

| Id | Card | Applies when |
|---|---|---|
| T-ANALYTICAL-EM | [Analytical electron microscopy](analytical-electron-microscopy.md) | the paper bases a claim on electron energy-loss or energy-dispersive X-ray spectra or maps recorded in a TEM, STEM or SEM, such as local composition, where an element sits, whether it is present, or bonding, valence or coordination |
| T-ARPES | [Angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy](arpes.md) | the paper reports angle-resolved photoemission data, or bases a claim about band dispersion, Fermi surface, energy gaps, surface or bulk states, orbital character or quasiparticle self-energy on them |
| T-CRYSTAL-GROWTH | [Bulk crystal growth and phase purity](crystal-growth.md) | the paper prepares bulk polycrystalline or single-crystal samples by solid-state reaction, flux or solution growth, floating zone, Bridgman or vapour transport, or bases a claim on a sample being phase pure, homogeneous, stoichiometric or representative of a compound |
| CL-PHASE-TRANSITIONS | [Claims of a phase transition](phase-transitions.md) | the paper claims that a phase transition or ordered phase sets in, assigns a transition temperature or critical point, states the order of a transition, reports critical exponents or a scaling collapse, or claims quantum critical or non-Fermi-liquid behaviour near a quantum critical point |
| CL-EXOTIC-GROUND-STATES | [Claims of new magnetic, ferroic or exotic ground states](exotic-ground-states.md) | the paper claims a new or unusual ground state, such as magnetic order, a spin glass, a quantum spin liquid, ferroelectric or multiferroic order, a charge or spin density wave or nematic order, or a coupling between such orders, whatever the technique |
| CL-SUPERCONDUCTIVITY | [Claims of superconductivity](superconductivity.md) | the paper claims that a material superconducts, reports a new or higher superconducting transition temperature (Tc), or bases such a claim on a resistance drop, diamagnetic shielding or flux expulsion, a heat-capacity anomaly, or critical fields or currents |
| T-COMPOSITION-ANALYSIS | [Composition and stoichiometry measurement](composition-analysis.md) | the paper states a composition, stoichiometry, oxygen content, dopant level or impurity content, or claims a sample is pure, from ICP-OES or ICP-MS, electron-probe microanalysis, Rutherford backscattering, SIMS, combustion or gas-fusion analysis, or thermogravimetry |
| T-TRANSPORT | [Electrical transport measurements](transport.md) | the paper reports resistance or resistivity, current-voltage characteristics, Hall effect or magnetoresistance data, or bases a claim about conductivity, carrier type, carrier density, mobility, contact resistance or an electronic transition on them |
| T-ELECTRON-MICROSCOPY | [Electron microscopy imaging and diffraction](electron-microscopy.md) | the paper bases a claim about crystal structure, phase, atomic arrangement, defects, interfaces, strain, particle size or morphology on transmission or scanning electron microscopy images, scanning transmission images, or selected-area or convergent-beam electron diffraction patterns |
| T-SPIN-RESONANCE | [Electron spin and ferromagnetic resonance](spin-resonance.md) | the paper reports electron spin or paramagnetic resonance g-factors, linewidths or spin counts, ferromagnetic resonance damping, anisotropy or g-factor, or spin pumping and inverse spin Hall voltages, or bases a claim about spin-mixing conductance or spin Hall angle on them |
| T-FIELD-EFFECT-DEVICES | [Field-effect and gated devices](field-effect-devices.md) | the paper reports transistor transfer or output curves, extracts field-effect mobility, threshold voltage, subthreshold swing, on/off ratio or contact resistance, or tunes carrier density with a solid, ionic-liquid or electrolyte gate |
| T-HIGH-PRESSURE | [High-pressure experiments](high-pressure.md) | the paper reports data taken in a diamond anvil, other opposed-anvil, piston-cylinder or gas pressure cell, or bases a claim about a pressure-induced transition, a pressure-temperature phase diagram or a pressure dependence on transport, magnetisation or other measurements in such a cell |
| T-MAGNETIC-IMAGING | [Local magnetic imaging](magnetic-imaging.md) | the paper images stray fields, magnetisation or current flow with nitrogen-vacancy magnetometry, scanning SQUID, Lorentz microscopy, electron holography, Kerr microscopy or X-ray magnetic microscopy, or bases a claim about domains, spin textures, local moments or current paths on such images |
| T-NEUTRON-SCATTERING | [Neutron scattering](neutron-scattering.md) | the paper reports neutron diffraction, inelastic neutron scattering or small-angle neutron scattering from solids, or bases a claim about a nuclear or magnetic structure, an ordered moment, phonons, magnetic excitations or spectral weight on neutron data; soft-matter scattering has its own card |
| T-NMR-MUSR | [NMR, NQR and muon spin rotation](nmr-musr.md) | the paper reports NMR or NQR spectra, Knight shifts or nuclear relaxation rates, or zero-, longitudinal- or transverse-field muon spin rotation or relaxation data, and bases a claim about magnetic order, its volume fraction, spin dynamics, superconducting pairing or superfluid density on them |
| T-OPTICAL-SPECTROSCOPY | [Optical absorption, reflectivity and ellipsometry](optical-spectroscopy.md) | the paper reports optical absorption, transmission or diffuse reflectance, a band gap from an absorption edge or Tauc plot, reflectivity with Kramers-Kronig analysis, spectroscopic ellipsometry, optical conductivity or terahertz spectra, or bases a claim about optical constants, carrier response or spectral weight on them |
| CL-PERSISTENT-CURRENTS | [Persistent currents](persistent-currents.md) | the paper claims a persistent or circulating current, quantized trapped flux or quantized circulation in a superconducting, normal-metal or semiconductor ring or a ring-shaped quantum gas, or bases such a claim on flux-periodic signals from SQUID, cantilever torque or Hall-probe measurements |
| T-PHOTOELECTRON-SPECTROSCOPY | [Photoelectron spectroscopy](photoelectron-spectroscopy.md) | the paper reports X-ray or ultraviolet photoelectron spectra (XPS, UPS, HAXPES), or bases a claim about surface composition, oxidation or chemical state, bonding, core-level binding-energy shifts, work function or energy-level alignment on them; angle-resolved photoemission has its own card |
| T-ULTRAFAST-SPECTROSCOPY | [Photoluminescence and ultrafast spectroscopy](ultrafast-spectroscopy.md) | the paper reports steady-state or time-resolved photoluminescence, a photoluminescence quantum yield, or pump-probe, transient absorption or transient reflection data, or bases a claim about carrier or exciton lifetimes, recombination, trapping, transfer or emission efficiency on them |
| T-QUANTUM-OSCILLATIONS | [Quantum oscillations and high magnetic fields](quantum-oscillations.md) | the paper reports de Haas-van Alphen or Shubnikov-de Haas oscillations, torque or other measurements in high DC or pulsed fields, or derives Fermi-surface areas, effective masses, quantum lifetimes, carrier densities or a Berry phase from oscillations periodic in inverse field |
| T-QUANTUM-TRANSPORT | [Quantum transport in mesoscopic devices](quantum-transport.md) | the paper reports conductance quantization, quantized Hall or edge-state transport in a device, Aharonov-Bohm or other interference oscillations, weak localization or antilocalization, nonlocal resistance, Coulomb blockade or shot noise, or bases a claim about coherence, edge channels or quasiparticle charge on them |
| T-VIBRATIONAL-SPECTROSCOPY | [Raman and infrared vibrational spectroscopy](vibrational-spectroscopy.md) | the paper reports Raman or infrared (FTIR, ATR) spectra, or bases a claim on them about phase or compound identity, phonon modes, crystal symmetry, strain, doping, defect density, temperature, layer number or crystallite size |
| T-INELASTIC-X-RAY | [Resonant and inelastic X-ray scattering](inelastic-x-ray-scattering.md) | the paper reports resonant inelastic X-ray scattering (RIXS), non-resonant inelastic X-ray scattering (IXS) or resonant elastic X-ray scattering, or bases a claim about magnons, paramagnons, orbital or charge excitations, phonons, electron-phonon coupling or charge order on them |
| T-SCANNING-PROBE | [Scanning probe microscopy](scanning-probe-microscopy.md) | the paper shows atomic force microscopy topography, magnetic force, Kelvin probe force, piezoresponse force or conductive atomic force microscopy data, or bases a claim about feature size, layer thickness, magnetic domains, surface potential, ferroelectricity or local conductivity on them |
| T-STM-STS | [Scanning tunnelling microscopy and spectroscopy](stm-sts.md) | the paper shows scanning tunnelling microscopy images, tunnelling spectra or conductance maps, or bases a claim about surface structure, local density of states, energy gaps or quasiparticle interference on them |
| T-NANOCRYSTAL-SYNTHESIS | [Solution synthesis and characterization of nanocrystals](nanocrystal-synthesis.md) | the paper reports nanocrystals or nanoparticles made by a colloidal, solvothermal or hydrothermal route and makes claims about their phase, composition, purity, shape, size distribution, yield or reproducibility |
| T-SPECIFIC-HEAT | [Specific heat and calorimetry](specific-heat.md) | the paper reports heat capacity from relaxation, ac or adiabatic calorimetry or differential scanning calorimetry, or bases a claim about a phase transition, its order or bulk nature, a latent heat, an entropy, an electronic coefficient or a Schottky term on it |
| T-MAGNETOMETRY | [SQUID and vibrating-sample magnetometry](magnetometry.md) | the paper reports magnetic moment, magnetisation or dc susceptibility measured with a SQUID or vibrating-sample magnetometer on a bulk, thin-film or nanoscale sample, or bases a claim about magnetic order, moment size, coercivity, anisotropy, a transition or blocking temperature or superconducting screening on them |
| T-THERMAL-TRANSPORT | [Thermal and thermoelectric transport](thermal-transport.md) | the paper measures thermal conductivity or diffusivity by steady-state, 3-omega or laser flash methods, measures Seebeck, Nernst or thermal Hall coefficients, or claims a thermoelectric figure of merit, a lattice thermal conductivity or a transverse thermal signal from particular excitations |
| T-THIN-FILM-GROWTH | [Thin-film growth and epitaxy](thin-film-growth.md) | the paper grows films or heterostructures by molecular beam epitaxy, pulsed laser deposition, sputtering, chemical vapour deposition or atomic layer deposition, or bases a claim on film thickness, composition, strain, interface quality, growth mode or a property attributed to the film rather than its substrate |
| CL-TOPOLOGICAL-INSULATORS | [Topological insulators](topological-insulators.md) | the paper claims that a material, film or device is a two- or three-dimensional topological insulator, or reports band inversion, topological surface or edge states, spin-momentum locking, quantum spin Hall or quantum anomalous Hall behaviour, from any measurement or calculation |
| CL-TOPOLOGICAL-SEMIMETALS | [Topological semimetals](topological-semimetals.md) | the paper claims a Weyl, Dirac or nodal-line semimetal, or reports Fermi arcs, a chiral anomaly or negative longitudinal magnetoresistance, a non-trivial Berry phase from quantum oscillations, or an anomalous or nonlinear Hall effect attributed to band topology |
| T-VAN-DER-WAALS | [Two-dimensional materials and van der Waals heterostructures](van-der-waals-materials.md) | the paper studies exfoliated or grown atomically thin layers or stacks of them, such as graphene, hBN, transition metal dichalcogenides or twisted moiré bilayers, and bases a claim on layer number, twist angle, stacking, strain, encapsulation or devices made from them |
| T-X-RAY-ABSORPTION | [X-ray absorption spectroscopy and magnetic dichroism](x-ray-absorption.md) | the paper reports X-ray absorption spectra (XAS, XANES, NEXAFS or EXAFS) or X-ray magnetic circular or linear dichroism, or bases a claim about oxidation state, coordination, bond lengths, element-specific spin or orbital moments, magnetic order or spin orientation on them |
| T-XRD | [X-ray diffraction](xrd.md) | the paper identifies phases, reports lattice parameters, strain, crystallite size, phase fractions, texture or epitaxy, or refines a crystal structure, from X-ray diffraction data |
